English: Servant Hut
A makeshift hut or lean-to for a handful of servants, hastily constructed from timber and thatch. Offers basic support for castle logistics.
Linen Room
A small, secured storage area for linens and supplies, improving the efficiency and morale of castle staff.
Chamber Servants' Room
A modest shared chamber for trusted castle servants, improving security and operational readiness.
Outer Quarters
Simple timber barracks at the castles edge, providing expanded living space for servants and support staff.
Inner Quarters
Sturdy stone-built quarters within the castle walls, offering safety and discipline for the expanded staff.
Expanded Servants' Hall
A large, vaulted hall for the castles many servants, enabling swift response to emergencies and improved morale.
Stewards Quarters
Lavish accommodations for the castle steward and senior staff. Enhances administrative efficiency and loyalty.
Household Barracks
A fortified barracks for household guards and elite retainers, providing robust defense and a professional garrison.
Staff Dormitory
A grand dormitory complex with secure entryways and ample amenities, ensuring excellent staff loyalty and rapid response to threats.
Grand Servants' Wing
An expansive, multi-story complex housing the elite staff of the castle, complete with guardrooms and administrative offices. The heart of castle administration and defense.
